items.title: Every day {from}–{to}
items.text: Evenings, weekends and holidays included. Pick a time that suits you straight from the calendar.

items.text: We bring the equipment. The sofa stays where it is.

items.text: After cleaning we dry the furniture with blower fans. It is part of every job at no extra cost.

services.title: What we clean
services.lead: All upholstered furniture at home and at the office. Prices are final and include stain pre-treatment, odor removal and blower drying.

sofas.title: Sofas
sofas.text: 2–6-seater sofas, corner sofas and chaise longues.

leather.title: Leather furniture
leather.text: Leather sofas and armchairs cleaned by hand with leather-safe products.

beds.title: Mattresses and beds
beds.text: Mattresses, box spring beds and toppers — dust, mites and stains gone.

chairs.title: Chairs
chairs.text: Dining chairs and office chairs, priced per chair.

odor.title: Odor removal
odor.text: Pet, smoke or damp odors are removed during the cleaning.

vehicles.title: Car upholstery
vehicles.text: Seats steam cleaned in your driveway or parking garage.

steps.title: From booking to a clean sofa in four steps

items.title: Book online
items.text: Choose the furniture, attach photos and see the price right away. The calendar shows times that are really free.

items.title: We come to you
items.text: We arrive at the agreed time with our equipment. All we need is a power outlet and water.

items.title: Steam cleaning and stain removal
items.text: We pre-treat stains, clean with steam and extract the dirt and detergent from the fabric.

items.title: Drying — free of charge
items.text: We finish by drying the fabric with blower fans. Left alone it would take 4–8 hours; we speed that up at no extra cost.

why.title: Clean fabric with no residue
why.lead: A good result depends on what is left in the fabric after cleaning. That is why we rinse and extract every surface thoroughly.

items.title: Drying is always included
items.text: We do not leave the sofa to dry on its own: after every cleaning we dry it with blower fans, free of charge.

items.title: Steam in every cleaning
items.text: Hot steam lifts dirt from deep in the fabric and reduces dust mites without harsh chemicals.

items.title: Allergy-friendly products
items.text: We use biodegradable, fragrance-free detergents that suit families with children and pets.

items.title: No detergent residue
items.text: We rinse and extract the fabric clean. A residue-free surface does not attract new dirt.

items.title: An honest estimate from photos
items.text: Attach photos to your booking. If the soiling is unusually heavy, we contact you and agree on the price before the visit.

items.title: Free re-clean
items.text: If you are not happy with the result, we come back. That is our satisfaction guarantee.

gallery.title: See the difference for yourself
gallery.lead: Drag the slider to see what steam cleaning does to the fabric.

pricing.title: Prices at a glance
pricing.lead: The same price in the price list, in your booking and on your invoice.
pricing.minOrder: Minimum order {min} before discounts. The price is final — if your photos show heavy soiling, we agree on the price with you before the visit.

b2b.title: Offices, hotels and restaurants
b2b.text: We clean office chairs, lobby sofas and restaurant benches when your premises are empty — early in the morning, in the evening or at the weekend.

area.title: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and surroundings
area.lead: We come to you anywhere in the Helsinki capital region and beyond. The exact travel fee is calculated from your postal code when you book.

items.q: How long does a sofa take to dry after cleaning?
items.a: Left alone, fabric usually takes 4–8 hours to dry. We dry the furniture with blower fans after cleaning, which speeds this up considerably — and drying is always included in the price.
Most do, but not all. Old, set-in or colour-changed stains may remain lighter but visible. Attach photos to your booking and we will tell you honestly in advance what to expect.

items.a: You get a confirmation by e-mail right away. The time is reserved for you immediately, so it disappears from the calendar for everyone else. We look at the photos you attached, confirm the booking by message or phone and let you know when we are on our way.

items.q: Do I need to pay in advance?
items.a: No. You pay only after the cleaning, once you have seen the result. The price is the same as in the booking, unless we agreed otherwise with you before the visit based on the photos.
Yes. The confirmation e-mail contains a link where you can reschedule or cancel the booking yourself. Please let us know as early as possible so someone else can take the freed slot.

items.q: What if I do not live in Helsinki?
items.a: There is no travel fee in the nearby area. Further away the fee is calculated from your postal code and shown in the booking before you confirm. If your postal code is outside our service area, ask for a quote on WhatsApp.

items.q: How long does the furniture take to dry?
items.a: We dry the furniture with blower fans after cleaning, and that is always included in the price. Left alone, fabric would typically take 4–8 hours and a mattress longer — with the blowers it is considerably faster.

items.q: Do I need to prepare anything?
items.a: Clear the furniture of loose items and make sure we can get around it. We need a power outlet and water. There is no need to vacuum beforehand.
